newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler sees Q4 production 0.8 pct lower.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler sees Q4 production 0.8 pct lower.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said Monday it plans to build a total of 693,700 cars and trucks worldwide during the 1996 fourth quarter, off 0.8 percent from the 699,400 vehicles it built during the same quarter of 1995.

Chrysler said the decrease reflects idling at Chrysler's Newark, Delaware, plant for retooling and some downtime at a Jeep Cherokee plant in Toledo, Ohio in November for model changeover. The decline also reflects the slow launch of a Dakota truck made at a Warren, Michigan, plant, a company spokesman said.
Chrysler said its 1996 fourth quarter car production in the United States, Canada and Mexico is expected to total 232,900 cars, up from 224,100 units built last year.
Fourth quarter truck production in the United States, Canada, Mexico and Austria is estimated at 460,800 units, down from 475,300 units built in the same quarter of 1995.
